overview.description: The Roundhill S&P 500 Target 10 Managed Distribution ETF (TPAY) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund is an actively managed fund, whose primary objective is to pay a monthly return of capital distribution at an annualized rate of ten percent, while providing exposure to the S&P 500 Index. The fund uses predominately FLEX call options to pursue this strategy. TPAY was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by Roundhill.

data.title: Roundhill Launches S&P 500® Target 10 Managed Distribution ETF (TPAY)
